archiGrad.io/gradient_architecture/compe.html: ·Larch is the only local timber with structural density
·fire charring creates a carbon layer that provides weather resistance and pest control without chemicals
·industrial Shrink Wrap 030mm use don the facade, flame retardant heat shrink wrap
·heat shrunk onsite to create a drum-tight skin to shed snow, block wind, and allow the dark timber skeleton to remain visible
·stands on four marine-grade coated steel legs
·minimizing pressure on the fragile soil
·detaching the structure from the ground eliminates the need for heavy floor insulation and protects the permafrost below
·Icelandic-Grown Siberian Larch, treated with the Shou Sugi Ban process
